summary: Phase 2 API migration testing completed. Found and fixed 3 regression bugs in the new /src/api/ modules. All pages now load correctly with proper data. Backend tests pass 100% (15/15).

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: getProjects() required orgId parameter but original API had orgId=null default
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added orgId=null default and conditional URL building to match original behavior

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: getDashboard() required orgId parameter but original API had orgId=null default
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added orgId=null default and conditional URL building to match original behavior

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: getNotifications(limit) used limit parameter but original API used unreadOnly boolean
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed parameter from limit to unreadOnly to match original API signature
